description: the whole Jarvis box on one GB10 (DGX Spark): chat, Drama 3 speech, Whisper transcription and the image model kept warm, video on demand; voice at /voice
tested_on: DGX-01 (NVIDIA GB10, DGX OS / Ubuntu 24.04, driver 580.178, CUDA 13.0), 2026-10-22

prereqs.title: jq, curl, git, tar, xz, sha256sum, sha1sum, python3, systemd-run
prereqs.test: for t in jq curl git tar xz sha256sum sha1sum python3 systemctl systemd-run; do command -v $t > /dev/null || exit 1; done
prereqs.fix: sudo apt-get install -y jq curl git tar xz-utils coreutils python3 systemd

prereqs.title: /usr/bin/python3 3.11 or newer (the Drama 3 worker and the qualification scripts)
the NVIDIA driver (nvidia-smi sees the GPU)
prereqs.fix: install the NVIDIA driver for this GPU (DGX OS ships it); then reboot

prereqs.title: CUDA 13's nvcc at $NVCC (builds LocalRouter's kernels and Drama 3's engine)
prereqs.fix: install the CUDA 13 toolkit (DGX OS: /usr/local/cuda); or set NVCC=/path/to/nvcc

prereqs.title: a systemd user session (the service is a user unit)
prereqs.fix: log in through ssh or a desktop session (not su); then: sudo loginctl enable-linger $(id -un)

prereqs.title: lingering, so the service runs without a login
Docker, usable without sudo, with the NVIDIA runtime (the image and video packs are built in NVIDIA's PyTorch container)
prereqs.fix: install Docker and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit (DGX OS ships both); then: sudo usermod -aG docker $(id -un), and log in again

prereqs.title: HTTPS to huggingface.co, github.com and ziglang.org
prereqs.test: for u in https://huggingface.co https://github.com https://ziglang.org; do curl -fsS -m 15 -o /dev/null -I $u || exit 1; done
prereqs.fix: open outbound HTTPS to those hosts (and download.pytorch.org, pypi.org, nvcr.io, raw.githubusercontent.com)

steps.title: Zig 0.17.0 (builds LocalRouter and Drama 3's engine)
steps.fix: a failed download or checksum: run again (it resumes); a checksum that keeps differing: the pinned file changed upstream, report it

steps.title: ffmpeg n9.0.2 static (video output and audio formats)
steps.fix: as for zig. BtbN prunes old autobuilds: if the URL is gone (HTTP 404), report it so the pin is moved to a current linuxarm64-gpl-9.0 asset

steps.title: LocalRouter itself, from this checkout (zig build with the CUDA kernels; about 3 minutes)
steps.fix: the log's last lines say why: a dirty checkout (git status; install from a clean one), no nvcc (doctor.sh), a compile error (report it with the log)

models.title: Qwen3.8 27B chat: TensorFold 1.1.4's native server, MLX 4-bit weights with the DFlash2 drafter
models.skip: leave chat out of --models; the voice loop then has no model to answer with

steps.title: the TensorFold archive, the checkpoint and the drafter (~20 GB), every file against pins.json
steps.fix: network: run again (partial files resume). 'differs, move it away first': delete the named file and run again. HF_TOKEN, if huggingface.co asks for one

steps.title: the binary runs here and sees the checkpoint; the tool config for qualify
steps.fix: the log names the check that failed (a missing library: report it with the log)

steps.title: the GPU qualification on this box (pins, direct, daemon, compare; about 5 minutes), which writes the marker the service needs
steps.fix: the run directory named in the log (under $J/qualify-chat/) has status.json, which says which step failed, and each step's log: not enough free memory: stop what holds the GPU (doctor.sh says what); anything else: report it with those logs

models.title: Fish Audio Drama 3 text to speech, NVFP4 pruned weights (TensorFold native engine, six named voices, streamed 44.1 kHz)

licence.name: Fish Audio Community License v1.0 (no hosted service: keep the service on loopback or your tailnet)

accept: the Drama 3 weights' licence (FACL v1.0; link below): plotarmordev/drama-3-NVFP4-Pruned is an unofficial community quant of fishaudio/drama-3 under it
the native engine's numerics as the box's Drama 3 baseline: it is not bit-exact with the SGLang-Omni reference (qualify.sh --accept-native-numerics)
lossy weights: routed experts in NVFP4 and pruned to 7,369 of 10,240 (qualify.sh --accept-lossy; docs/dev/DRAMA3.md has its measured quality against the full model)
models.skip: leave tts out of --models; the box then has no speech model and the voice loop cannot speak

steps.title: the drama-tensorfold checkout, the launcher, the voices and the NVFP4 checkpoint (22.3 GB; files a full checkpoint already holds are linked), every file against its pins
steps.fix: network: run again (partial files resume). A dirty or wrong checkout: delete $DRAMA_ROOT/drama-tensorfold and run again

steps.title: the TensorFold engine for the NVFP4 weights, with LocalRouter's voice prefix cache (zig and nvcc; about 15 minutes)
steps.fix: the log's last lines: a wrong zig or nvcc version (doctor.sh), else report it with the log

steps.title: the qualify config: the deployed Drama 3 tool with this box's paths
the GPU qualification (assets, e2e, bench; about 20 minutes; upstream's accuracy checks do not apply to the lossy weights), which writes the marker the service needs
steps.fix: the run directory named on the last line (under $J/qualify-drama3/) has status.json, which says which step failed, and each step's log (assets.log, e2e.log, bench.log): not enough free memory: stop what holds the GPU; anything else: report it with those logs

the checkpoint at its pinned revision (1.6 GB), every file by sha256
steps.fix: network: run again (a file that failed its check is downloaded again)

models.title: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo text to image (FP8, 8 steps; LocalRouter's own engine)

licence.name: Qwen Research License: non-commercial research or evaluation only

accept: the Qwen-Image 2.1 and 2.1 Turbo licences (links below)
models.skip: leave image out of --models; spoken picture requests then fail with 'no image model'

steps.title: the Qwen-Image 2.1 and Turbo checkpoints (47 GB, every file against its pin) and the image venv, in NVIDIA's PyTorch container (pulls the 20 GB container once)
steps.run: LOCALROUTER_HOME=$J/lr WEIGHTS_ONLY=1 DOWNLOAD_ONLY=1 MODELS=image IMAGE_MODELS=qwen-image-2.1-turbo PRECISIONS=fp8s bash $REPO/tools/spark/install.sh && $STEPS stamp image-download $REPO/tools/twin/packs/sources/qwen-image-2.1.json $REPO/tools/twin/packs/sources/qwen-image-2.1-turbo.json
steps.fix: exit 137 (killed): the box ran short of memory; the download container is capped at 8 GiB (LR_PREPARE_MEMORY), so free that much (INSTALL.md step 6) and run again. Network: run again (finished files are kept, hf resumes the rest). 'differs from': the named directory's .verify.log lists the file; delete it and run again. Docker errors: doctor.sh

steps.title: the FP8 Turbo, text-encoder and VAE packs (checked against their pins) and the Triton kernels for this GPU (about 30 minutes)
steps.run: $STEPS free 64 && LOCALROUTER_HOME=$J/lr WEIGHTS_ONLY=1 MODELS=image IMAGE_MODELS=qwen-image-2.1-turbo PRECISIONS=fp8s bash $REPO/tools/spark/install.sh && python3 -I $REPO/tools/package/verify_assets.py $REPO/tools/twin/packs/built/qwen-image-2.1-turbo.json $J/lr/weights/qwen-image-2.1 && $STEPS stamp image-packs $REPO/tools/twin/packs/built/qwen-image-2.1-turbo.json
steps.fix: network: run again (finished parts are kept). 'differs from': the named file is not the pinned one; delete it and run again. Docker errors: doctor.sh

models.title: MiniMax H3 text to video with audio (NVFP4 Turbo pack, 8 steps; on demand: it unloads the image model while it runs)

licence.name: MiniMax H3 Community License: excludes the US, EU, UK and South Korea, with downstream use conditions

steps.run: LOCALROUTER_HOME=$J/lr WEIGHTS_ONLY=1 DOWNLOAD_ONLY=1 MODELS=video bash $REPO/tools/spark/install.sh && $STEPS stamp video-download $REPO/tools/twin/packs/sources/minimax-h3.json
steps.fix: exit 137 (killed): the box ran short of memory; the download container is capped at 8 GiB (LR_PREPARE_MEMORY), so free that much (INSTALL.md step 6) and run again. Network: run again (finished files are kept). 'differs from': $J/lr/models/minimax-h3.verify.log lists the file; delete it and run again. Docker errors: doctor.sh

steps.title: the Turbo-LoRA NVFP4 pack (calibrated on the GPU, about 15 minutes) and the engine's layout, checked against their pins
steps.run: $STEPS free 64 && LOCALROUTER_HOME=$J/lr WEIGHTS_ONLY=1 MODELS=video bash $REPO/tools/spark/install.sh && python3 -I $REPO/tools/package/verify_assets.py $REPO/tools/twin/packs/built/minimax-h3.json $J/lr/weights/minimax-h3 && $STEPS stamp video-packs $REPO/tools/twin/packs/built/minimax-h3.json
steps.fix: exit 137 (killed): as for image/download. Network: run again (finished downloads are kept). 'differs from': delete the named file and run again. Docker errors: doctor.sh
